 Print FMGE October 2026 The National Board of Examinations in Medical Sciences (NBEMS) is set to release the admit card for the Foreign Medical Graduate Examination (FMGE) October 2026 on October 27. Candidates who have registered for the screening test will be able to download their hall tickets from the official website, natboard.edu.in. The examination is scheduled to be held on October 31, 2026. NBEMS has already released the city intimation slip, which allows candidates to check the city allotted to them for the examination. Candidates will need their login credentials to access the city slip and admit card. The city intimation slip provides details of the examination city but does not mention the exact examination centre. How to download the FMGE October 2026 admit card 
 Candidates can follow these steps to download their admit cards once the link is available: Visit the official NBEMS website at natboard.edu.in.
 Open the examinations section and select FMGE.
 Look for the October 2026 admit card link.
 Log in using the required credentials.
 Open the admit card and check the details.
 Download and save the document.
 Take a printout for the examination day.
 Candidates should check their personal details, examination centre information and other instructions mentioned on the admit card. Documents required on the exam day
 Candidates must carry a printed copy of their admit card and a valid identity proof to the examination hall. They should also read the instructions given on the admit card and follow the examination guidelines issued by NBEMS. Candidates are advised to visit the official website regularly for updates regarding the FMGE October 2026 examination.
